title: Clinical Trial Protocol Summary - Phase II CardioX Study
content: Investigational Drug Study Summary for CardioX (Protocol CX-202): Multicenter Phase II trial evaluating novel ACE2 activator in patients with chronic heart failure. Sample size: 450 randomized participants across 12 medical centers. Primary efficacy endpoint achieved: 78.4% demonstrated statistically significant improvement in left ventricular ejection fraction. Adverse reaction rate was low at 4.2%. Development cost to date: $2,400,000.00.
